questions.stem: What does ECL stand for in data transformation?
questions.explanation: ECL stands for Extract, Convert and Load, and is mainly used in Text Analytics.

questions.stem: In ETL processing, where do the Extract, Transform and Load operations run?
options: Extract on the source, Transform and Load on the target
Extract and Transform on the target, Load on the source
questions.explanation: In ETL the Extract, Transform and Load parts all run on the source system, including the push of data to the target table.

questions.stem: In ELT processing, how many of the six operations run on the target system?
questions.explanation: In ELT only two of six operations run on the source; four, including the Transform operation, run on the target system.

questions.stem: What is the first step of ELT processing?
options: Running the Transform on the source
Loading data into the final table
Creating a temp table (DDL) in the target system
questions.explanation: ELT is DDL-EL-ETL: first a temp table is created in the target, then data is extracted and loaded one-to-one into it before being transformed and loaded on the target.

questions.stem: Which operation is described as the most resource-hungry in ETL or ELT processing?
questions.explanation: The Transform operation is the most resource-hungry, which is why ELT runs it on the target system.

questions.stem: In which field is ECL processing mainly used?
questions.explanation: ECL is mainly used in Text Analytics, where tools read text from Word, PDF or text files, catalogue it with tags and load it into target storage.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT within the scope of ECL processing?
options: Converting unstructured video, audio, scans or images into structured data
Cataloguing text by giving it tags
Loading tagged text into a target storage
questions.explanation: ECL is about converting or tagging data that is already in text format, not about turning video, audio, scans or images into structured data.

questions.stem: Which tool vendors will always suggest having a Landing Area in the target system?
questions.explanation: ETL tools' sales teams always suggest a Landing Area, whereas ELT tools' sales teams normally do not, because ELT already creates a temp table in the target.

questions.stem: How is Data Transformation described in relation to ETL developers and KPIs?
options: A concern only for database administrators
The bread and butter of ETL developers and the starting point of any KPI
questions.explanation: Data Transformation is the bread and butter of ETL developers and data engineers, and the starting point of any KPI.

questions.stem: Which sequence of operations technically describes ELT processing?
questions.explanation: ELT has three more operations than ETL and is technically DDL-EL-ETL: create a temp table, extract and load into it, then extract, transform and load on the target.
